Navistar Defense, LLC Super Senior Revolver | Fair Value at March 31, 2026 45,818,273

findings.detail: Affiliate rollforward positions were extracted in addition to the Schedule of Investments; their 355,919,417 fair value exactly equals the over-coverage residual.

rationale: The filing's Schedule of Investments reports debt and equity fair value of 657,323,982, while the extracted position sum is 1,013,243,399. The 355,919,417 excess equals exactly 246,700,365 of controlled-affiliate fair value plus 109,219,052 of non-controlled-affiliate fair value from the separate affiliate rollforward tables. Navistar's 45,818,273 revolver appears in both the Schedule of Investments (table 4 row 4) and the rollforward (table 8 row 2), proving supplemental-table duplication rather than a bad filing anchor.
